description: This file defines the class LeaveRequestCommentDecorator, which provides methods to manipulate and access LeaveRequestComment entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for setting related entities and formatting date/time information.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that adds utility methods for LeaveRequestComment entities, including setting related entities and formatting timestamps.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a LeaveRequestComment entity.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment based on an employee number.

methods.name: setCreatedByUserById
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment based on a user ID.

methods.name: setLeaveRequestById
methods.description: Associates the comment with a LeaveRequest based on its ID.

methods.name: getCreatedAtDate
methods.description: Returns the creation date of the comment formatted as Y-m-d.

methods.name: getCreatedAtTime
methods.description: Returns the creation time of the comment formatted as H:i.
